b: Merzbow, The Ex and more will play the Liverpool event next May
The Ex, photo by Maarten Mooijman
Outer Waves has shared the first wave of acts playing its 2027 edition.
The festival returns to Liverpool for its third edition next May, and will take over the venues Invisible Wind Factory, Make. and Quarry. The lineup will be headed up by Merzbow and The Ex.
Also confirmed to play are Nihiloxica, Sex Swing, Poor Creature, Palestinian Sound Archive, Penelope Trappes, Ancient Grains, Those Holy, Cowtown, The Aleph and All Maudra.
More names will be added to the bill in the coming months.

Outer Waves will take place from 15 to 16 May 2027. Find more information here.
